## Induction
:::

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Sum | $\sumto{i}{n} a_i = a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n$ |
| [Induction](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/induction.html#def-proof-by-induction) ($b, k, n \in \bbZ$) | $(P(b) \land (\forall k \ge b, (P(k) \Rightarrow P(k + 1)))) \Rightarrow (\forall n \ge b, P(n))$ |
| Base case | $P(b)$ |
| Inductive step | assume $P(k)$ (the induction hypothesis), show $P(k + 1)$ |

: Induction. {#tbl-ns-induction tbl-colwidths="[42,58]"}
